observed_problem: The raw file must stay immutable.
intended_transformation: Refuse to clean if the hash differs. Never open the raw path for writing.
why_appropriate: A later step cannot silently replace the source.
validation_method: V01 and V21 compare the hash before and after cleaning.

observed_problem: Source tokens are already the published values.
evidence: Profile found no whitespace damage and no numeric parse failures.
intended_transformation: Copy every source cell as text.
why_appropriate: Preserves FIPS zeros and one-decimal versus integer prevalence tokens.
information_loss: None. The cleaned file is wider only because derived columns are appended.
validation_method: V04 and V06 compare headers and every source cell.

observed_problem: No exact duplicate rows and no row failed an identifier check.
evidence: 3143 unique full-record hashes and 3143 unique CountyFIPS.
why_appropriate: Deleting a county would drop a real geography.

evidence: The CSV header and columns.json both use this spelling. The 2024 GIS file used the same spelling.
why_appropriate: The published name is the join key to CDC documentation.
validation_method: V04 asserts the published name is still present.

observed_problem: 44576 measure cells are empty. They are exactly the Kentucky/Pennsylvania 2023 block and the 11-state HRSN block.
evidence: Empty string only. No N/A or Suppressed token. Four fields of a measure are all empty or all present. CDC FAQ: estimates are not reported below 50 adults; this file has no such county. CDC: HRSN covers 39 states and DC.
intended_transformation: Leave blanks empty. Do not impute.
why_appropriate: Filling them would invent model estimates. The pattern is structural.
information_loss: The blanks remain. Users must not treat them as zero.
validation_method: V06 source equality; V16 and V17 recompute the state blocks.

observed_problem: Codes are already five-character text with leading zeros.
evidence: 318 codes start with 0. The minimum code is 01001. Los Angeles is 06037.
intended_transformation: Do not cast to integer and do not pad or truncate.
why_appropriate: Arithmetic conversion would destroy leading zeros.
validation_method: V07 checks the five-digit pattern and the 318 leading zeros.

observed_problem: No leading whitespace, trailing whitespace, or whitespace-only cells.
Kalawao has 81 residents. Sumter County cholesterol screening is 93.3. Madison County stroke is 1.7.
evidence: Values sit inside 0 to 100. Populations are positive and agree with known small and large counties.
why_appropriate: An extreme model estimate can still be the published estimate. Intervals carry the uncertainty.
validation_method: V13 and V18 retain the range and Kalawao.

affected: 12 rows sharing a short name inside a state
observed_problem: Baltimore, St. Louis, Fairfax, Franklin, Richmond, and Roanoke each occur twice in one state.
evidence: The two rows have different FIPS codes. They are a county and a county-equivalent.
intended_transformation: Do not drop either row and do not rewrite CountyName.
why_appropriate: County name is not a key. Rewriting names without a downloaded gazetteer would mix our labels with CDC labels.
information_loss: Users who group by name alone will merge different places. The collision flag marks the rows.

observed_problem: Intervals are text like ( 2.8,  3.5) with padding spaces.
evidence: Every non-blank interval matched the same regular expression. Zero order errors. Zero estimates outside the interval. The CDC FAQ confirms the percent scale.
intended_transformation: Append derived low and high columns using the exact numeric substrings. Keep the source text.
why_appropriate: The format was verified on the whole file before parsing.
information_loss: None of the source text. Derived bounds do not add precision beyond the printed numbers.

evidence: 3143 of 3143 match. Coordinates are inside WGS84 limits. Metadata calls the field the county centroid.
intended_transformation: Append derived longitude and latitude as the exact printed substrings. Keep the WKT.
why_appropriate: Same standard as the interval parse.

observed_problem: An audit index is useful and is not a CDC field.
evidence: Row order in the CSV is not documented as a key.
intended_transformation: Append derived__source_row_number as 1 through 3143 in file order.
why_appropriate: It points back to the raw file without changing geography.
information_loss: None. It must not be used as a FIPS substitute.

observed_problem: Six short names are shared by two county-equivalents.
evidence: Computed from the file. See the profile table.
intended_transformation: Append derived__short_name_collision as yes or no. Do not change CountyName.
why_appropriate: The flag is a fact about this file. The legal class is documented beside it and is not written as a fake CDC name.
validation_method: V09 compares the flag with a fresh count and with the 12 known FIPS codes.

observed_problem: The published short name is the mojibake of Doña Ana.
evidence: Bytes are UTF-8 for U+00C3 U+00B1. A Latin-1 round trip yields U+00F1. FIPS 35013 is Doña Ana County, New Mexico. No other non-ASCII name exists.
intended_transformation: Set derived__CountyName_display to the repaired spelling for that exact FIPS and exact token only. Leave CountyName unchanged.
why_appropriate: The source cell stays auditable. A global encoding repair is not applied.
information_loss: The source column still shows the mojibake if someone reads CountyName.
validation_method: V11 checks this cell and that every other display value equals CountyName.
